Faq.title: Got questions? We've got answers.
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our premium physical and digital wedding invitations.
Faq.a1: Rimba Digital is a daughter company of Rimba Wedding (est. 2001) operating in Wedding Technology (WedTech). We help digitalize your wedding orchestration elegantly—from premium web invitation platforms to automated WhatsApp RSVPs and digital guestbooks (QR Check-in).
Faq.q2: How does the automated RSVP system work?
Faq.a2: Every guest receives a unique web invitation with their name personalized automatically. When a guest confirms attendance, it instantly syncs to your personal Dashboard in real-time and triggers an automatic notification update to your WhatsApp.
Faq.q3: Can I personalize the guest names on the invitations?
Faq.a3: Yes, absolutely! Guest name personalization is an essential, unlimited core feature. Simply insert your guest list into the Dashboard, and our system instantly generates customized, unique links for each individual guest automatically.
Faq.q4: What is the purpose of the QR Code Check-in feature?
Faq.a4: It facilitates quick guest validation at the venue using a unique QR Code on their invitation. It coordinates guest entry, records attendance in real-time, manages souvenir distribution, and automatically tracks table allocations smoothly.
Faq.q5: Can I customize the background music and photo gallery?
Faq.a5: Yes, indeed! All invitation packages support full customization. You are free to upload unlimited photos, embed pre-wedding videos, and choose favorite background soundtracks that play elegantly and seamlessly.
Faq.q6: Is there a limit to the number of invitations I can send?
Faq.a6: There is no limit at all! You are free to share your premium digital invitations with as many guests, friends, and family as you wish, with absolutely no hidden charges or per-guest fees.

Reviews.title: What our couples say...
Reviews.r1Content: Rimba Fisik's Heartwood Series invitations completely wowed our guests. The gold hot-stamping foil was flawlessly brilliant, and the 600gsm heavy cotton paper felt extremely luxurious to the touch.
Reviews.r2Content: As a professional wedding planner, Rimba Fisik's print quality is exceptionally consistent. My clients are always amazed—from deep traditional letterpress to elegant blind debossing, the detail is incredibly precise.
Reviews.r3Content: We chose the Leaf Series with organic leaf blind debossing and it surpassed our expectations. Crisp elegant typography over natural textured linen paper—simple, eco-friendly, yet deeply memorable.
Reviews.r4Content: The custom design consulting process was incredibly smooth. The Rimba Fisik team patiently guided us to select the exact paper weight and hot stamping techniques that matched our forest wedding theme.
Reviews.r5Content: The combination of natural wooden textured accents and gold foil letterpress was breathtaking. It captured the exact rustic elegance we wanted for our wedding invitation cards. Our guests kept texting us about how beautiful they were!
Reviews.r6Content: Unbelievable tactile premium feel. We wanted an invitation that wasn't just paper, but a physical keepsake. Rimba Fisik delivered a masterwork of card design. Absolutely recommended for any couple wanting high-end invitations!
Reviews.r7Content: Minimalist layout, stark borders, and perfect hairline spacing. The typography is so clean. It's a gorgeous marriage of traditional craftsmanship and modern design sensibility.
Reviews.r8Content: We received endless compliments from friends. They said it was the most elegant invitation card they had ever held. It felt like opening a high-end exhibition card.
Reviews.r9Content: From first sketch to packaging, their team treated our cards like fine art. Rimba Fisik's commitment to perfection is unmatched. Absolute best in the print industry.
